purpose: Permit a minimal exact-blob-pinned class of trusted self-hosted control-plane health workflows without weakening the canonical A-01 qualification gateway. These workflows may validate controller/governance state but may not execute arbitrary qualification subjects or untrusted pull-request code.
rules: The frozen legacy-direct-workflows registry remains unchanged; this is a separate trusted-control class.
Canonical A-01 qualification payloads still route through a01-control-plane-gateway -> admission broker -> executor.
A trusted-control workflow must match its registered Git blob SHA exactly or fail closed.
A trusted-control workflow may not run on pull_request, schedule, or repository_dispatch unless explicitly permitted by this registry.
A trusted-control workflow may not accept arbitrary command/input payloads.
A trusted-control workflow must use the shared a01-global-r2 concurrency domain so it cannot overlap native qualification on the single A-01 runner.
A trusted-control workflow cannot call the A-01 gateway, broker or executor unless explicitly permitted.
A workflow registration or policy change is a permanent security/governance change and requires explicit user authority under CANONICAL-WRITER-POLICY-001.
Native branch/ruleset protection remains the desired hard GitHub boundary when private-repository plan capabilities permit it.
